summary: Merged source in PRs #4530 and #4531 extends the existing ordinary work-programme entry rather than adding an execution framework. The workflow redirects the bounded runner result, then always attempts display and a separately scheduled artifact upload, so display failure does not suppress upload; missing output or failed upload remains a reporting failure. Static --preflight checks the actual suite inventory, known launcher shapes, entrypoint membership, required tools and declared input closure without workload launch. Normal execution carries preflight candidate hashes into subsequent identity checks and rejects intermediate symlinks; a fresh hash baseline after preflight would silently admit changed caller bytes. Negative controls reproduce input and intermediate-directory mutation before first launch and require zero children. Existing original deadlines, first cause, independent diagnostics and cleanup semantics remain intact. Hosted actual-entry qualification was observed passing all nine suites at the exact selected candidate; this is source and selected hosted acceptance, not installed receiver or packaged native diagnostic adoption. Preflight cannot discover undeclared dynamic reads or provide hostile-process containment, native resource admission, publication authority, two-workload capacity acceptance or comparative savings. V3-IMPROVE-01.1 and V2-DIAG-01.4 retain their remaining owning-plan assertions.
title: Assembled programme candidates retain pins and independent diagnostic evidence
